topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I can scarce believe what I heard, the talk about the quill scrawling secrets in the night, tales woven from the whispers of the hearth. To think, all the while, she sat there, penning shadows of us. Every laugh, every silent look, captured, turned into words. I feel like the soil, tilled and turned over, laid bare. The trust, like rain promised but never falling, leaving the earth dry and thirsty. What world is this, where a man’s heart is used for stories? I ought to read it, find out what’s been sown in my name. But what if I find nothing I know, or worse, truths I feared? The saints have their trials, but this, this feels like a test no prayer can ease.
